entities.summary: Vladimir Ricardino Carval Jeronimo, known as Vladimir Ricardino or Vladimir Jeronimo, is an Angolan basketball player and a former member of the Angola national basketball team. He stands 6 ft 4 in (1.93 m) tall and plays as a guard. He competed for Angola at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
